# 02 "Reset view" control-bar button, plus demo verification

## Outcome

The default control bar now shows a fourth "Reset view" button alongside Prev/Next/Reset, calling
`board.resetView()`. `demos/step-reveal.html` and `demos/complex-showcase.html` — both already
`@siren/board` consumers, unmodified by this slice — are visually verified to still work, now with
functioning drag-to-pan, wheel-to-zoom, and the new button, proving the feature end to end without
a code change to either demo page.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The default control bar (`createDefaultControls`) renders a fourth button, "Reset view", after
      Prev/Next/Reset, calling `board.resetView()` at click time (read-at-click-time, same pattern
      as the existing three buttons).
- [ ] Clicking "Reset view" does not change `board.controller.currentStep` or `totalSteps`.
- [ ] Clicking the existing "Reset" button does not change the current pan/zoom view (i.e. does not
      call `board.resetView()`'s effect) — the two buttons remain independent.
- [ ] `options.controls: false` still renders no control bar at all (including no "Reset view"
      button); a custom `ControlsFactory` still fully replaces the bar — both unchanged from today,
      confirmed by a test.
- [ ] `demos/step-reveal.html` and `demos/complex-showcase.html`, run via
      `pnpm --filter @siren/core build && pnpm --filter @siren/board build` and served locally,
      show a working "Reset view" button, drag-to-pan, and wheel-to-zoom, with no console errors and
      no code changes needed to either demo file (both already call `createBoard` with default
      options).

## Test seam

Same as ticket 01: `createBoard`/`Board`, integration tests under jsdom for the button-click
assertions. The demo criterion is manual/visual verification (headless-Chrome screenshot or
equivalent), not a new automated test — matching tickets 03/04 of the original board slice.
